introTitle: Can a model always be right?
adaptationScope: This is a first digital adaptation, not the complete workbook. It adapts the pool decision and threshold-neuron activities from chapter 2, pages 6–8 of Workbook_Teil1.pdf. The original PDF/ZIP remains available from the landing page.
introText: A classifier follows its inputs and learned rules. Record your initial opinion and give a reason in the text field below. Return to it after the experiment.
opinionPrompt: Can a model make the right decision in every situation?
neuronTask: Find weights and a threshold that predict visits on Wednesday and Friday only. Inputs use 1 for Lina being available, at least one friend being available, homework being finished, and sunny/warm weather. Try weights 0, 1 and 2. Several solutions may work.
neuronExplanation: Multiply each input by its weight and add the products. The output is 1 when the sum is greater than or equal to the threshold, otherwise 0. This is one threshold neuron, not a trained image-recognition network.
invalidNumbers: Enter finite numbers in every field. The last valid parameters remain saved; the table still shows those parameters.
boundaryPrompt: What is the output when the weighted sum equals the threshold?
weightPrompt: Which statements describe this neuron? Select all that apply.
effectWeighted: A weight changes how strongly its input affects the sum.
effectThreshold: The threshold determines when the output is active.
effectAlwaysRight: Matching five examples guarantees correct decisions in every new situation.
reflection: Explain your solution. What can five matching examples tell us, and what can they not tell us?
answerSaved: Opinion saved. There is no automatic right/wrong grade.
binaryTableTitle: Encode the week as binary inputs
binaryTableTask: Use 1 when a condition is true and 0 otherwise. Monday is filled in as an example. On Tuesday, Lina is unavailable, a friend is available, homework is unfinished and the weather is not sunny/warm. On Wednesday, Lina and a friend are available, homework is unfinished and it is sunny/warm. On Thursday, Lina is unavailable, a friend is available, homework is finished and the weather is not sunny/warm. On Friday, Lina and a friend are available, homework is finished and it is sunny/warm.
tableSaved: All cells filled. Answers saved; this table has no automatic grade.
tableIncomplete: Fill in every editable cell. Answers are saved as you work.
